newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains in pre-holiday doldrums.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains in pre-holiday doldrums.

text.p: Trading on the UK physical grains market was showing signs of drifting into the pre-holiday doldrums on Tuesday.
"Business hasn't really got going this week and unless something totally unexpected happens, trade will almost certainly come to a halt before the end of the week," said a trader.
Buyers and sellers were around one stg apart on the fob market with Jan/Mar feed wheat bid 100 stg and offered at 101. There was a seller for Apr/Jun at 103 stg with the nearest buyer at 102 stg.
Delivered trade was mainly for nearby material with feed wheat trading in East Anglia at around 99 to 99.50 stg for spot with 99 stg paid for Jan in the Avon range.
Barley in Suffolk fetched 98 stg for Jan with 99.50 stg paid in the Avon range.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein fetched 118.50 stg in the middle of the country for Jan/Mar and 117 stg in south west England.
